title: Affine and empty-open cases of perfect-complex descent
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, (R_i) a directed system of Noetherian rings, c a colimit cocone, i an index, and s:X_i → Spec R_i a finitely presented morphism. Let U be an affine open of X_i or the empty open. Then P(U) holds, where P is [def-pc-perfect-descent-on-open]. In particular the descended object and comparison map are precisely the base changes specified by that predicate.

source.place: Tag 09RF, proof: affine case using Tags 08EB and 0BC7; empty base case of compact-open induction

proof.text: For an open-immersion presentation f:Z → X_i with affine image U, Z is affine and quasi-compact. The composite t=s∘f is finitely presented. On the directed tail j≥i, write its affine base changes as Spec A_j and its limit base change as Spec A. Affine base change identifies A_j with A_i tensor_(R_i) R_j, and the colimit universal property gives A = colim A_j. Perfectness implies quasi-coherent cohomology. Apply [lem-pc-perfect-affine-bounded-projective] to represent E by a bounded complex P of finite projective A-modules.

Apply [lem-pc-affine-perfect-colimit-descent] on this tail and transport across the specified colimit isomorphism to obtain a bounded finite projective complex P_j with scalar extension P. Sheafify P_j on the affine stage. Its projective terms are locally summands of finite free modules, so the result is perfect. Flatness of these terms computes its derived pullback by termwise scalar extension, giving the isomorphism to E for the canonical map. The tail index supplies j≥i. For U empty, Z and all its base changes are empty. Module sheaves and their derived categories on the empty space have only the zero object up to unique isomorphism; the zero object at j=i is perfect and descends E. This also covers zero rings and an empty affine source.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_descent_affine_open
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj i)]
    (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (s : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U : Xi.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U ∨ U = ⊥) :
    PerfectDescentOnOpen R c i Xi s U
